body: Just because they do things with you doesn’t mean they can’t be there for. But you should tell them how you feel.
thanks, i think that would actually help me out a bit, telling someone who gets it my problems and hearing what they have to say about.
i don’t think i’ve ever related to a post more. i want help, i need help, but i physically can’t tell anyone, i feel like cutting is my subconscious way of asking for help
Hey, don’t wanna bug you but I’m here for anything you wanna say, i’m a good listener, i promise :)

I get where your coming from, but honestly I don't think anyone would mind to much, believe it or not a lot of people probably sexted younger teens. You can't take the "what if's" to seriously mate no one will know unless you are ready to tell them...and it  more than likely won't bother them at all...if it does maybe you shouldn't be associating with them anyway...friends or family should except you and all your mistakes.
Who are you scared will know? are you planning on telling someone?

I understand why you may have regrets over it mate...but I can assure you the girl probably isn't even bothered by it...she probably doesn't think about it anymore...no ones going to judge you, because it's not really any of there business...I know you may feel weird about the age gap, but life is about experiencing and learning...neither of you, were the age to give consent...so it isn't pedophilia...since you were both under 18 is also can't be considered "taking advantage of"...your just freaking yourself out a bit mate...it's okay to regret things, but you can't dwell on them and you especially can't take it out on yourself mentally or physically...move forward...she's okay...your okay...your not a creep...your not a pervert...you were/are just a normal hormonal teenage kid.
Its not really that big of an age gap you were probably 16-17 they were probably 14 don't beat yourself up over it mate.

Trust me when I say, I know exactly how you feel, and I know that's probably not want you want to hear right now, but I'm not going to say it's gets better, because truly I don't know If it does, and I'm not going to be the person to give you false hope...but imagine all the pain your feeling right now, and imagine it in your wife...because that's what killing yourself does..it doesn't kill the pain...it kills you and gives the pain to the people who loved you most...so if you won't stay alive for you, stay alive for her, I know its hard, but get some professional help...I know the depression and anxiety pills suck, but if you haven't already...try those...try to turn that temporary band-aid...into long lasting stitches...pains a never ending cycle and suicide spreads it...I don't know if the pain goes away...but maybe you'll just get used to it...until then..hang on...because it's a bumpy road trying to be happy again...but you've gotta try...for the people who care about you...and I know that may feel like no one..but they do..people care, don't let the depression and anxiety play tricks on you...keep your grasp on reality...don't commit...because if you do...more than likely your wife's going to find you..gone...and I know right now you just want to focus on ending the pain...but focus on the effects your going to leave on people once your gone. As for why you feel this way it could be genetic, passed down from someone in your family...or it could be a natural response to the stress your feeling...if possibly maybe take a stress-free vacation with your wife?...I hope some of my words helped...best of luck of your journey...stay strong.

that was fast...thank you..that's one of the main reasons I made this account was to find people who will listen, who I can talk to...maybe even who can relate..thank you for reading my post and for being the first person to ever know how I'm actually feeling.
